name: Closet Compass
demoJourney: On a phone, photograph a wardrobe, coach or evaluate a profile photo, or collect private daily entries and export an editable Markdown self-reflection.
acceptanceCriteria: A phone user can capture or select an image under 10 MB.
With a configured vision-provider key, the server returns grounded visible garments, style and exactly three gaps.
Without a configured vision-provider key, the UI offers clearly labelled demo results rather than presenting them as analysis.
The user can correct or remove detected garments before following recommendations.
A user can upload a portrait, receive technique-only coaching and optionally display or mirror a deterministic dotted pose guide.
Photo Coach does not score appearance or infer sensitive personal traits.

A consenting adult can receive blunt scores, appearance observations, possible reactions from women, tentative visual-type guidance, searchable clothing/colour/haircut upgrades and non-identifying reference-image searches.
Digital Twin stores entries and photos locally, sends only written evidence for synthesis, and exports an editable Markdown reflection.
The public health endpoint and all four product pages pass smoke tests for the deployed commit.
